name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in his uncle's small metalworking shop in rural Thailand. He honed his skills crafting everything from farm equipment to intricate Buddhist statues. A chance encounter with a touring rally team sparked his fascination with racing machines. He was immediately drawn to the raw power and the challenge of keeping them running. 

He joined Reiza Racing Academy after years of working with local racing teams. Somchai's approach to fabrication is meticulous, bordering on artistic. He views each component as a piece of a larger puzzle, constantly seeking ways to improve its design and functionality. His colleagues know him for his ability to diagnose complex mechanical problems with just a glance and a tap of his wrench. What sets him apart is his uncanny ability to 'feel' the metal, sensing weaknesses and stresses that others might miss.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight widow's peak
physical.description: A wiry man of medium height, Somchai has a focused gaze and hands calloused from years of working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting any project.
Has a lucky wrench that he refuses to let anyone else touch.
Humming traditional Thai songs while welding.
